Lee Valley Riding Centre
Lee Valley Riding Centre is British Horse Society approved and offers horse riding lessons for beginners through to more experienced riders as well as superb equestrian facilities, including 5 star livery services and top class tuition in London.
71 Lea Bridge Road
London
E10 7QL
